edge.title: Replace Muon by Muown (row weight-norm g·v/‖v‖) + power-law cooldown
edge.summary: MuownDP reparametrizes every hidden matrix row-wise as W = g·v/‖v‖: the direction v takes a Nesterov-momentum, 12-step Polar Express orthogonalized step of size lr·0.2·√max(m,n) computed from the tangential weight-norm gradient, while the per-row gains g get bias-corrected Adam at the same lr; there is no weight decay. A v-norm schedule moves the stored ‖v‖ from its initial row norm toward 2.496 (×3.33 for mlp.proj) with progress ((t−1)/3164)^1.2, so the angular step shrinks over training on top of the LR schedule, which becomes a power-0.9 cooldown whose horizon (3165) lies past train_steps (3090, claimed 3075). Aux AdamW lrs are raised (embed 0.6, head 0.009375, 1-D 0.03).

changes.label: Muown weight-norm optimizer (MuownDP)
changes.detail: _wn_pre_ns rebuilds v = (W/g)·v_norm and splits ∇W into grad_g = Σ_row ∇W·(W/g) and grad_v = (g/v_norm)(∇W − (W/g)·grad_g); v ← v − lr·0.2·√max(m,n)·polar(grad_v + 0.95·m_v) with m_v ← 0.95·m_v + grad_v; _wn_recompose writes W = g·v_new/‖v_new‖_row.

changes.label: Adam on per-row gains g, no WD
changes.detail: g (init = row norms; all-zero rows → 0.33**0.5) gets bias-corrected Adam with betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8 at the Muown lr; neither g nor v has weight decay.

changes.label: V-norm schedule (angular step decay)
changes.detail: After each step v_norm = lerp(v_norm_init, 2.496·family_mult, min((t−1)/3164, 1)^1.2), mult 3.333 for mlp.proj and 1 elsewhere; a larger stored ‖v‖ makes the same v step a smaller rotation of W's rows.

changes.label: Polar Express orthogonalization
changes.detail: zeropower_via_polar_express_long uses 8 tuned (a, b, c) quintic coefficient triples (the last repeated) for 12 iterations instead of the fixed (2, −1.5, 0.5) polynomial.

changes.label: Power-law cooldown, horizon 3165
changes.detail: lr_eta = 1 until 30% of LR_SCHEDULE_STEPS=3165, then ((1 − step/3165)/0.7)^0.9 for both optimizers; with train_steps 3090 the LR ends at ≈5% of peak instead of 0.

changes.label: train_steps 3350 → 3090, claim 3075
changes.detail: 25-step validation after 90% of 3090; 3075 is an intermediate checkpoint (LR ≈5.7% of peak).

changes.label: Harness rewrite
changes.detail: DATA_DIR/glob loader with a missing-file error, RANK/WORLD_SIZE env, fixed num_trials=30 with per-trial model rebuild and seeds 0–29, config print, complexity-sorted params broadcast from their owner rank instead of all_gather.

hparams_changed.label: hidden lr
hparams_changed.to: 0.00325 (v step = lr·0.2·√max(m,n); also g Adam lr)

edge.parent_check: Inferred #12 is a reasonable base (keeps #12's init, aux groups and 25-step late validation), but the optimizer and harness are rewritten. The nearest-code #21 (Shampoo) is dated 05/13, after #23 (05/10), and shares only the #12-family harness.
edge.noise: Harness rewrite: env-driven DATA_DIR/RANK/WORLD_SIZE, 30 seeded trials in one process with model rebuilds, config print, per-step time print removed, owner-rank broadcasts, docstrings.

mechanisms.name: Muown (weight-normalized Muon with row-norm control)
mechanisms.explain: MuownDP treats each hidden matrix as rows W_i = g_i·v_i/‖v_i‖: every step it rebuilds v with the scheduled row norm v_norm, takes the weight-norm gradients (grad_g = radial component of each row's gradient; grad_v = (g/v_norm)·tangential part), steps v by −lr·0.2·√max(m,n)·PolarExpress12(grad_v + 0.95·m_v) with m_v ← 0.95·m_v + grad_v, steps g by bias-corrected Adam (0.9, 0.95, eps 1e-8) at the same lr, and writes back W = g·v_new/‖v_new‖ (no weight decay). Row norms of W are therefore set only by the Adam-trained gains, while the direction gets an orthogonalized step whose angular size is lr·0.2·√max(m,n)/v_norm per row. After each step v_norm ← lerp(v_norm_init, 2.496·mult, ((t−1)/3164)^1.2) (≈0.574 → 2.496, ≈4.3× growth; ≈14.5× for mlp.proj), an explicit angular step-size decay that replaces what WD-free weight-norm growth would do implicitly.

mechanisms.name: Power-law cooldown with a schedule horizon past the run
mechanisms.explain: lr_eta(step) is 1 while step < 0.3·3165 and ((1 − step/3165)/0.7)^0.9 afterwards — equivalently min(1, c·(T − t)^0.9) — applied to AdamW and Muown alike. Because LR_SCHEDULE_STEPS=3165 exceeds train_steps=3090, training stops while the LR is still ≈5% of peak.

caveats: readmes/rec_23.md describes an earlier submission (lr_muown 0.0035, v-norm target 2.688, embed lr 0.9, smoothstep v-norm interpolation, separate linear cooldowns, 3200 steps, 10 seeds → 3125) that matches the folder's other log (97782bd6); the record's log (a26c8aa2) uses lr 0.00325, target 2.496, embed lr 0.6, a ((t−1)/3164)^1.2 ramp, a power-0.9 cooldown to 3165, 3090 steps and 30 trials (claimed 3075). The zero-initialized hidden proj matrices get gain 0.33**0.5 per row at state init, so after the first Muown step their rows have norm ≈0.574: the zero init lasts one step. 'PowerCool' here is #23's own ((1−p)/0.7)^0.9 form, not #20's per-group c·(t_end−t)^1.2 constants.
